paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 65a. Dikdukei Soferim gives the reading R' Chanina bar Papa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Chanina reading is attributed to Dikdukei Soferim by Hyman; it is not a new manuscript collation.

The heading explicitly has Rav Chanin; the reported alternative Chanina has an abbreviated title, retained as R'. דק״ס is conventionally expanded as Dikdukei Soferim, preserving the original inference qualification. The reading is Hyman’s apparatus report, not independently checked collation. Eruvin65a follows the period convention without a named-edition check.
